topics.title: Basic Controls
topics.text: Move with {move} and jump with {jump}. Press {attack} to attack. When a prompt appears over a person or an object, press {interact} to talk, open or pick it up.
topics.hint: Button to open the game menu.

topics.title: The Map
topics.text: The minimap in the top right shows the rooms around you. Open the full map to see everything you have explored so far; while it is open, {move} moves the view and you stand still.
topics.hint: Button to open or close the full map.

topics.title: Saving Your Progress
topics.text: Look for save points along the way. Step up to one and choose a save slot — there are four. To pick up where you left off, choose Continue on the title screen.
topics.hint: Button at a save point to save your game.

topics.title: The Journal
topics.text: The Journal in the game menu follows the story. Quests lists each part of the Prologue with its objectives; Characters keeps the people you have met; the Bestiary records the enemies you have met and killed.
topics.hint: Button to open the game menu, then choose Journal.

topics.title: Moving and Jumping
topics.text: Move with {move}. Press {jump} to jump. {dodge} dashes — twice in a row, even in the air.

topics.title: Training 1/4 — Attack
topics.text: Training 1 of 4. Press {attack} three times quickly: the third swing staggers. While you learn, neither of you can fall. {cutscene_skip} skips the training.

topics.title: Training 2/4 — Dodge or Block
topics.text: Training 2 of 4. When his weapon glints, dash through the blow with {dodge} or hold {block} to take it on your guard. A red glint cannot be blocked: dodge it.
topics.hint: Dash through the blow, or hold block.

topics.title: Training 3/4 — Parry
topics.text: Training 3 of 4. A yellow glint means a blow you can parry: tap {block} just as it lands. No damage, he reels, and your next attack is a heavy riposte.
topics.hint: Tap it as the yellow-glint blow lands to parry.

topics.title: Training 4/4 — Heavy Attack
topics.text: Training 4 of 4. Press {heavy_attack} while he is not swinging: a slow wind-up, then a blow that breaks his guard.

topics.title: Attacking
topics.text: Enemies ahead! Press {attack} to swing your weapon. Keep pressing to chain a combo of three swings — four with a weapon in each hand. The last swing of a combo staggers.

topics.title: Heavy Attack
topics.text: Press {heavy_attack} for a heavy attack: a slow wind-up, then a blow that breaks an enemy's guard and staggers it. A hit during the wind-up interrupts it, so pick your moment.

topics.title: Block and Parry
topics.text: Hold {block} to block: a hit from the front does no damage (a heavy blow or the last hit of a combo breaks the guard). When an enemy's weapon glints yellow, tap {block} just as the blow lands — that is a parry: no damage, and the attacker is staggered and open to a counter. A red glint cannot be blocked or parried: roll out of the way.
topics.hint: Hold to block; tap it as a yellow-glint blow lands to parry. Roll from a red glint.

topics.title: Experience and Coins
topics.text: Defeated enemies leave XP and coins. The XP bar fills with each kill; when it is full you level up, gaining HP, damage and a skill point.

topics.title: Levelling Up
topics.text: Each level raises your HP and damage and gives a skill point. Spend points in the game menu under Skills.
topics.hint: Button to open the game menu, then choose Skills.

topics.title: Healing Palm
topics.text: Level up! You can learn Healing Palm — press {game_menu}, open Skills, select it and confirm. It goes to your skill bar; press {skill_slot_1} to heal.
topics.hint: Button for the first skill slot.

topics.title: Equipping Gear
topics.text: Grandfather gave you a sword and armour — press {game_menu}, open Inventory and use them to equip, or choose a slot in Equipment.
topics.hint: Button to open the game menu.

topics.title: Calling an Ally
topics.text: Companions fight at your side — press {assist} to call one. Call the guard now!
topics.hint: Button to call the next ready companion.

topics.title: Companions
topics.text: Allies you meet can join your party: choose who goes with you in Status. {assist} calls the next ready companion.
topics.hint: Button to call the next ready companion.

topics.title: Choosing Companions
topics.text: New companions are ready to join you. Open {game_menu}, go to Status → Companions and press a card to take that companion along; the order you pick is the order {assist} calls them. Only the ones you pick come to help.
topics.hint: Button to call the next ready companion.
